plate_comment: The engine misfire monitor (e2m Misfire_* block), run from cm848_phase_group_b_processing every second main loop phase (10 ms if a phase is one 5 ms PIT tick): with the engine at a warm steady idle it overfuels one cylinder at a time in firing-order slots 1-5-3-6-2-4 (test fueling = cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal + (total_injection_quantity + that trim) x misfire_monitor_fuel_multiplier_percent / 100, 20 percent + 20 percent per attempt), lets cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse compare the cylinder's response with misfire_monitor_response_limit, and retries up to misfire_monitor_attempt_limit (5) before it flags the cylinder. Phases (misfire_monitor_phase_code): 0 off / 1 armed, waiting for the tool's run request / 2 done / 3 aborted by a timeout / 4 running; steps (misfire_monitor_step_code): 0 wait for the test conditions and the slot's event / 1 wait between cylinders / 2 apply the test fueling / 3 measure / 4 report: sets the faults of the flagged cylinders 361-366 (P0301-P0306, fault numbers per slot in ROM 0x64548) and fault 367 (P0300) when two or more are flagged, clears the others / 5 none flagged: clears all seven / 6 wait until the fault bits settle, then end in phase 2 with diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits 0x100 set and the misfire bit 0x100 cleared in fault_pending_flags (or fault_pending_flags_b). The outcome is misfire_monitor_result; while a test runs it also holds the cylinder balance code off (misfire_monitor_cylinder_balance_suspend_flag) and enables its speed buffers (misfire_monitor_speed_buffer_enable_flag). Off on this truck: operating_mode_flags_cal 0x7ca6 has the enable bit 0x8000 clear (RAM dump: phase 0) (was hpcr_coldBurndownControl)
evidence: ROM 0x5985a[361..367] -> obd_dtc_code_table = P0301..P0306 and P0300 (fault 367 is set only here, fault_setters.py); ROM 0x64548 = fault numbers 361 365 363 366 362 364 416 417 per firing-order slot; the function sets / clears those bits in steps 4 and 5 and the readiness bits in step 6, so detecting and healing the misfire faults is its whole job. ROM block 0x6445c-0x6447a = e2m Misfire_* (0x01164E00 + offset: attempt limit 5, fuel ramp 20 / initial 20, LSG offset 640 = 80 rpm, load 17920 = 70 %, max speed 7200 = 900 rpm, throttle 2 = 0.5 %, vehicle speed 512 = 2 mph, coolant 8960 = 140 F, idle time 300 = 3 s at 0.01 s per pass); RAM block 0x40b9ee-0x40ba18 = e2m Misfire_Cyl_N_Attempt_Number ... Misfire_CBD_Enable (0x01165100 + offset). The old cold burndown / cbd names came from a misread: CBD = cylinder balancing (e2m Group_Cylinder_Balance), whose speed buffers this monitor borrows.

plate_comment: Resets the misfire monitor's running test: test cylinder number 1, total attempt / idle pass / cylinder wait / event wait / flagged cylinder counts 0, step 0, misfire_monitor_result 0, the warm idle / disabled-by-fault / speed buffer enable / cylinder balance suspend / event index advanced flags 0, and for each of the cylinder_event_count_max cylinders the attempt count 0 and the misfire flag 1. Called whenever the test conditions are lost (every step of cm848_runMisfireMonitor, cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse) and by cm848_initializeMisfireMonitor (was engine_sync_state_init)
evidence: Stores in the decompile: 0x40ba13 = 1, 0x40ba14 / 0x3fd20f / 0x3fd20d / 0x3fd211 / 0x3fd1fe = 0, 0x3fd222 = 0, 0x40ad84 = 0, flags 0x3fd207 / 0x3fd209 / 0x40ba18 / 0x40ba16 / 0x3fd21b = 0, and the per-cylinder loop (sthx 0x40b9ee, stbx 0x3fd1ff); nothing in it is an engine sync.

plate_comment: Initializes the misfire monitor at application start (called from cm848_applicationMain): clears misfire_monitor_warm_up_pass_count, resets the test, stores the current idle reference speed, then sets the phase: 0 (off) when bit 0x8000 of operating_mode_flags_cal (e2m Misfire_Monitor_Enable) is clear - this truck, 0x7ca6 -, else 4 (run on its own once per key cycle) when misfire_monitor_tool_only_enable is 0, else 1 (wait for the tool's run request) (was cm848_initGovernor)
evidence: lhz operating_mode_flags_cal @ 0x532bd8 and & 0x8000, lha 0x64477 @ 0x532bf0 (e2m Misfire_Monitor_Tool_Enable), stw phase / step @ 0x532c0c / 0x532c28 / 0x532b30; it initializes no governor state (the only governor read is the idle reference copy).

plate_comment: Sets misfire_monitor_conditions_valid_flag to 1 when every misfire test condition holds, else 0: no fault of misfire_monitor_disabling_fault_numbers (ROM 0x6447e, 100 fault numbers) is active (the list is skipped when engine_sync_type_code is 5100), cold_start_phase is at the governor setpoint, the filtered engine speed (engine_rpm_state_t.target_rpm, the moving average of engine_rpm_measured) is within misfire_monitor_idle_reference_speed_offset of the idle reference (governor_output_t.integrator high word) and at most misfire_monitor_maximum_engine_speed, load at most misfire_monitor_maximum_engine_load, accelerator demand under misfire_monitor_maximum_accelerator_demand, governor_fuel_demand_mode 11, the idle reference equal to misfire_monitor_idle_reference_speed_previous, coolant at least misfire_monitor_minimum_coolant_temperature (or, with type code 5100, the warm-up passes done), vehicle speed under misfire_monitor_maximum_vehicle_speed and bit 0x4000 of protection_feature_status_flags still equal to misfire_monitor_start_status_bit_state (was engine_cbd_sync_qualification_check)
evidence: Called by steps 1-3 of cm848_runMisfireMonitor and by cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse; the same comparisons as step 0 of the main state machine, limits are ROM 0x64461-0x6446f.

plate_comment: Ends one misfire monitor pass over all cylinders: restarts the test cylinder number at 1, counts the cylinders whose misfire flag is set into misfire_monitor_flagged_cylinder_count and picks the next step: 5 (none flagged: clear their faults) or 4 (report the flagged ones) (was cylinder_event_counter_check_active)
evidence: Loop over cylinder_event_count_max bytes at 0x3fd1ff (misfire_monitor_cylinder_misfire_flags), stb count @ 0x532e0c / 0x532e40, step stw 5 or 4; called only from cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse.

plate_comment: Evaluates the cylinder under test: reads the response value cylinder1_timing_offset[misfire_monitor_cylinder_response_index_map[slot]] (ROM 0x6455a: 2 3 4 5 0 1 6 7), stores it in misfire_monitor_cylinder_response_values and compares it with misfire_monitor_response_limit; above the limit it adds an attempt and returns to step 2 for more fuel until misfire_monitor_attempt_limit (5) is used up and the cylinder's misfire flag is set, at or below it clears the flag. It then restores the cylinder's fueling offset to its learned trim, goes to step 1 with the next cylinder number, and after the last cylinder re-checks the conditions and calls cm848_countFlaggedMisfireCylinders (was engine_cbd_cylinderTiming_update)
evidence: cmpw limit, response; blt @ 0x532ec8 / 0x532ecc (signed halfwords); lhax 0x40b74c @ 0x532ea8 through the ROM 0x6455a byte map; sthx 0x40b9fe @ 0x532eb4; flag stbx 0x3fd1ff @ 0x532f20; restores cylinder_fueling_offset from cylinder_balance_fueling_trim_cal @ 0x532f4c / 0x532f50.

Misfire monitor phase: 0 off (operating_mode_flags_cal bit 0x8000 clear - 0 in the RAM dump) / 1 armed, waiting for the tool's run request / 2 test done / 3 aborted by a timeout / 4 running the cylinder test; set by cm848_initializeMisfireMonitor and cm848_runMisfireMonitor (stw / lwz @ 0x532c0c / 0x532c28 / 0x532fc4 / 0x533004 / 0x53302c). Accessed as a dword while the row is typed word, so it renders as _cbd_phase_code

Misfire monitor step, the switch of cm848_runMisfireMonitor: 0 wait for the test conditions and the slot's event / 1 wait misfire_monitor_cylinder_wait_pass_limit passes between cylinders / 2 apply the test fueling / 3 wait for and evaluate the response / 4 report the flagged cylinders / 5 none flagged / 6 wait for the fault bits to settle; written by the monitor functions as a dword (stw @ 0x532b30 / 0x532c18 / 0x532e70 / 0x532f0c / 0x533370; typed word, renders as _cbd_step_code)

The high word of governor_output_t_0040aec2.integrator - the low speed governor's idle reference speed in 1/8 rpm, 6000 = 750 rpm in the RAM dump - as of the previous pass, stored on every exit of cm848_runMisfireMonitor (sth @ 0x533ad4) and by cm848_initializeMisfireMonitor (0x532bd0); cm848_checkMisfireMonitorTestConditions and step 0 require it to equal the current reference (lhz @ 0x532d50 / 0x5332c4), so a changing idle target aborts the test

Misfire monitor step 0 latch: set when cold_start_phase is at the governor setpoint and the engine is warm (coolant at least misfire_monitor_minimum_coolant_temperature with bit 0x4000 of protection_feature_status_flags, or with engine_sync_type_code 5100 the warm-up pass count above misfire_monitor_warm_up_seconds_cal x 100); cleared when a cylinder test starts and by cm848_resetMisfireMonitorTest (stb @ 0x532b40 / 0x53316c / 0x53323c)

Set to 1 when a fault from misfire_monitor_disabling_fault_numbers is active (never with engine_sync_type_code 5100: the list is skipped); step 0 resets the test while it is 1, so 1 means the monitor is held off, not enabled (stb @ 0x532b1c / 0x532c48 / 0x532ca4 / 0x5331fc / 0x533290, lbz @ 0x532cbc / 0x5332e8)

Result of cm848_checkMisfireMonitorTestConditions (stb @ 0x532dec): 1 = every misfire test condition holds; steps 1-3 and the end of a pass reset the test when it is 0 (lbz @ 0x532f70 / 0x533430 / 0x533488 / 0x5335a8)

Passes (10 ms each) the idle test conditions have held in step 0: it waits until the count reaches misfire_monitor_minimum_idle_pass_count (300 = 3 s), then holds it at 299 so each later cylinder starts at once; zeroed by cm848_resetMisfireMonitorTest (lhz @ 0x533208, sth @ 0x533210 / 0x533234 / 0x532b00)

Step 1 counter: passes between two cylinder tests, up to misfire_monitor_cylinder_wait_pass_limit (30), then step 0 picks the next cylinder; zeroed when a cylinder test starts and by cm848_resetMisfireMonitorTest (sth @ 0x53344c / 0x533454 / 0x533478 / 0x533390 / 0x532b08)

Passes spent waiting for the fueling event (step 2, limit misfire_monitor_fueling_wait_pass_limit 18) or the response event (step 3, limit misfire_monitor_response_wait_pass_limit 26); at the limit the test aborts (phase 3, misfire_monitor_result 4); zeroed after every event and by the reset (sth @ 0x533584 / 0x533624 / 0x533604 / 0x533658 / 0x532b10)

Firing-order slot of the cylinder under test, 0-based = misfire_monitor_test_cylinder_number - 1 (slots 0-5 = cylinders 1-5-3-6-2-4); indexes misfire_monitor_cylinder_attempt_counts, the fault numbers at ROM 0x64548 and cylinder_fueling_offset (sth @ 0x533388, lhz @ 0x532e88 / 0x533310 / 0x5334b8)

The cylinder_event_index at which the test fueling of the slot is applied: slot + 4 for slots 0-1 and slot - 2 for slots 2-5 (two events before the cylinder fires, modulo 6); steps 2 and 3 wait for cylinder_event_index to reach it (sth @ 0x5333d4, lhz @ 0x5334a0 / 0x5335c8)

Set when cylinder_event_index has moved off the wanted event (step 0: the slot, step 3: the fueling event), so the next match is a fresh event and not the stale one; cleared when used and by the reset (sth @ 0x53332c / 0x533350 / 0x5335dc / 0x53360c / 0x532b58)

Number of cylinders whose misfire flag is set after a complete pass (cm848_countFlaggedMisfireCylinders, stb @ 0x532e0c / 0x532e40); step 4 sets fault 367 (P0300) when it is 2 or more and clears it below 2; zeroed by the reset (stb @ 0x532b24, lbz @ 0x5337a4)

One byte per firing-order slot (typed byte, indexed by the slot): 1 = the cylinder is flagged as misfiring (its response stayed above misfire_monitor_response_limit through all attempts), 0 = cleared; the reset sets 1 for cylinder_event_count_max slots (RAM dump 1 1 1 1 1 1 0 0), step 4 turns each 1 into the cylinder's fault bit (fault numbers ROM 0x64548) and each 0 into a clear (stbx @ 0x532b90 / 0x532f20, lbzx @ 0x532e2c / 0x5336b4)

Limit the cylinder response is compared with (read signed, lha @ 0x532ec4), set in step 2 (sth @ 0x533564): misfire_monitor_absolute_response_limit (500), or the cylinder's earlier response + misfire_monitor_relative_response_margin (500) when bit 0 of protection_feature_flags (e2m Misfire_Relative_Enable) is set - this truck, 0x67be, so the absolute limit

The service tool's command to run the misfire monitor (e2m Misfire_Monitor_Run, 0x01165124 + offset): nothing in the firmware sets it (whole-binary sweep: one store, the clear in step 0 @ 0x533368). Phase 1 waits for it, phases 2 and 3 start a new test on it (lbz @ 0x532ff4 / 0x53301c), and step 0 clears it when the first cylinder test starts

Word set to 1 by cm848_runMisfireMonitor step 0 while a cylinder test waits for or runs its events (sth @ 0x5332fc), cleared at the end of a pass by cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse (sth @ 0x532f94) and by the reset (0x532b48); hpcr_cbdFillAccelerationBuffers, hpcr_processLoadThrottle (0x42cfc, the cylinder balance fuel demand blend) and hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims read it (lhz @ 0x42be4 / 0x42c04 / 0x42d10 / 0x42d9c) to run the cylinder event speed buffers from the tooth misfire_monitor_speed_buffer_start_tooth even when cbd_enable_flag is 0 (e2m Misfire_CBD_Enable, 0x0116512A)

Word set to 1 by cm848_runMisfireMonitor step 0 while a cylinder test waits for or runs its events (sth @ 0x533304), cleared at the end of a pass by cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse (sth @ 0x532f8c) and by the reset (0x532b50); the cylinder balance trim code (hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims, lhz @ 0x435b8 / 0x439a8) and the cylinder contribution test (cm848_runCylinderContributionTest, lhz @ 0x43b4c) hold while it is non-zero (e2m Misfire_CBD_Compensation_Disable, 0x01165128). Not an engine sync debounce

Test attempts per firing-order slot (word array, e2m Misfire_Cyl_N_Attempt_Number 0x01165100 + offset): each attempt raises the test fuel multiplier by misfire_monitor_fuel_multiplier_step_percent; at misfire_monitor_attempt_limit (5) the cylinder is flagged; zeroed by the reset, summed into misfire_monitor_total_attempt_count in steps 4 / 5 (sthx @ 0x532b8c, lhzx @ 0x532ee0 / 0x5334d8 / 0x5336ac / 0x533864); replaces the cold-burndown debounce wording

With engine_sync_type_code 5100 counts the passes spent at the governor setpoint (it is zeroed when not there) up to misfire_monitor_warm_up_seconds_cal x 100 + 1: that is the warm-up condition of step 0 in place of the coolant test (sth @ 0x5330ec, lhz @ 0x5330c4 / 0x533150 / 0x532d88; e2m Misfire_In_Plant_Delay_Timer); cleared by cm848_initializeMisfireMonitor (0x532bbc), not by the reset

1-based firing-order slot of the cylinder to test next (e2m Misfire_Test_Cylinder_Number): 1 after the reset, +1 per finished cylinder, one past cylinder_event_count_max when the pass is complete (stb @ 0x532aec / 0x532dfc / 0x532f38, lbz @ 0x532f30 / 0x532f54 / 0x533378)

Sum of the per-cylinder attempt counts, added up when the result is reported in step 4 or 5 (e2m Misfire_Total_Attempts_Number); zeroed by the reset (sth @ 0x532af8, lhz @ 0x533690 / 0x533834, sth @ 0x53379c / 0x5338dc)

EEPROM 0x4c5 (inside the mirror), 18 in the RAM dump and the EEPROM dump: with engine_sync_type_code 5100 the monitor warms up for this many seconds (x 100 passes of 10 ms) at the governor setpoint (lbz @ 0x532d90 / 0x5330cc / 0x533158). The same byte is the Chrysler end-of-line misfire test's warm-up time (e2m CHRY_In_Plant_MFM_Delay_Time) and is read by engine_protection_timerState_shiftCheck (lbz @ 0x52f370)

Outcome of the last misfire test: 0 not run / 1 running / 2 all cylinders good / 3 at least one cylinder flagged / 4 aborted by a timeout (sth @ 0x532b38 / 0x533044 / 0x53335c / 0x53364c / 0x533668 / 0x53380c; read at 0x533a88). cm848_j1939HandlePgn58112Dm7 sends it as the test-1 result of its J1939 DM8 answer (lhz @ 0x22810) and engine_protection_timerState_shiftCheck passes the end-of-line test on 2 (lhz @ 0x52f3cc) - there is no destination in it

Per-cylinder fueling trim in firing-order slots (word array, 0.0679 mm3 per count), learned by the cylinder balance code (hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims adds into it) and kept in the EEPROM mirror (EEPROM 0x1a00, so _cal; e2m CBD_Delta_Fueling_Trim_N 'saved at power-down'): 30 -5 -12 -2 3 -14 in the RAM dump. The misfire monitor starts its test fueling from it and restores cylinder_fueling_offset to it after every test (lhax @ 0x532f4c / 0x5334fc / 0x533508)

Per-cylinder fueling offset in firing-order slots, typed byte but a word array (the cylinder balance code writes the trim scaled by its compensation factor, once as two bytes; the RAM dump holds the trim array): the injection code adds it to the cylinder's quantity and clamps the sum to 0..5888 (lhax @ 0x527764, add / clamp @ 0x527768-0x527788). cm848_runMisfireMonitor overwrites the tested cylinder's entry with the test fueling (sthx @ 0x533524) and cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse restores it (sthx @ 0x532f50)
Misfire monitor: test attempts allowed per cylinder before it is flagged - 5 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Attempt_Limit; lbz @ 0x532ee8)
Misfire monitor: test fuel multiplier added per attempt, percent - 20 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Fuel_Ramp_Slope 0.01; lhz @ 0x5334cc)
Misfire monitor: test fuel multiplier of the first attempt, percent - 20 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Initial_Fuel_Multiplier 0.01; lhz @ 0x5334c4)

Misfire monitor: the filtered engine speed (engine_rpm_state_t.target_rpm) may be at most this far above the idle reference - 640 = 80 rpm at 1/8 rpm (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_LSG_Ref_Speed_Offset; lhz @ 0x532cec / 0x533190)
Misfire monitor: engine_load_at_current_speed_percent must be at most this - 17920 = 70 percent at 1/256 percent (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Low_Load_Threshold; lhz @ 0x532d18 / 0x5331bc)
Misfire monitor step 3: passes to wait for the response event before the test aborts - 26 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Maximum_Cylinder_Event_Count 'wait for speed information'; lhz @ 0x533630)
Misfire monitor step 2: passes to wait for the fueling event before the test aborts - 18 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Maximum_Cylinder_Wait_Count 'wait when calculating fueling'; lhz @ 0x533590)
Misfire monitor: the filtered engine speed (engine_rpm_state_t.target_rpm) must be at most this - 7200 = 900 rpm at 1/8 rpm (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Maximum_Engine_Speed; lhz @ 0x532d00 / 0x5331a4)

Misfire monitor: fuel_demand_control_t.calculated (accelerator demand, 0.25 percent per count) must be below this - 2 = 0.5 percent (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Maximum_Throttle; lhz @ 0x532d30 / 0x5331d4)
Misfire monitor: vehicle_speed must be below this - 512 = 2 mph at 1/256 mph (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Maximum_Vehicle_Speed; lhz @ 0x532dac / 0x5332b4)
Misfire monitor: coolant temperature must be at least this (signed compare) - 8960 = 140 F at 1/64 F (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Minimum_Coolant_Temperature; lha @ 0x532d6c / 0x533120)
Misfire monitor: the cylinder response limit when bit 0 of protection_feature_flags is clear - 500 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Minimum_Delta_Time; lha @ 0x53355c)
Misfire monitor: passes of steady idle before the first test - 300 = 3 s at 0.01 s per pass (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Minimum_Idle_Time; lhz @ 0x533218)
Misfire monitor: added to the cylinder's earlier response to make the limit when bit 0 of protection_feature_flags is set - 500 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Minimum_Relative_Delta; lha @ 0x53354c)
Misfire monitor: 0 = it runs on its own at key-on, nonzero = it waits for the tool's run request - 0 here (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Monitor_Tool_Enable; lha @ 0x532bf0)

Misfire monitor: crank tooth at which hpcr_cbdFillAccelerationBuffers starts the cylinder event speed buffers while misfire_monitor_speed_buffer_enable_flag is 1 (instead of cbd_sync_byte_a_cal) - 15 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Start_Tooth; lbz @ 0x42c14)
Misfire monitor step 1: passes between two cylinder tests - 30 (ROM constant, e2m Misfire_Test_Wait_Count; lhz @ 0x533460)

Misfire monitor: 100 fault numbers (0 = unused slot; e.g. 8 / 9 boost sensor, 16 / 17 coolant temperature sensor, 29 = P0500, 62-64, 68, 268-292, 303-305, 328-335, 354, 375-376, 386-388, 401, 408-409, 415, 358-360); any one active holds the monitor off (e2m Misfire_Error_Disable_Table; lhzx @ 0x532c7c / 0x533268, loop of 100)

Misfire monitor: fault number per firing-order slot - 361 365 363 366 362 364 (P0301 P0305 P0303 P0306 P0302 P0304 through ROM 0x5985a and obd_dtc_code_table) and 416 417 (cylinders 7 / 8, no DTC slot; the engine has 6): lhzx @ 0x5336d8-0x5338a8 in steps 4 and 5

Misfire monitor: slot -> index into cylinder1_timing_offset of the response to read - 2 3 4 5 0 1 6 7 (the cylinder fires two events after its fueling event; e2m Misfire_Cylbal_Cylinder_Map; lbzx @ 0x532ea0)

Misfire monitor: bit 0x4000 of protection_feature_status_flags (1 set / 0 clear) as of the start of the cylinder test (stb @ 0x5333ac); cm848_checkMisfireMonitorTestConditions requires the bit to still match (lbz @ 0x532dd0). Copy-window RAM (time-shared with the boot kernel image, no boot call lands on it) - no _cal

Misfire monitor step 0: the firing-order slot before the one about to be tested (slot - 1, cylinder_event_count_max - 1 for slot 0); stored only (sth @ 0x5333f8 / 0x533410, whole-binary sweep: no reader). Copy-window RAM - no _cal

Misfire monitor step 2: the test fuel multiplier in percent = misfire_monitor_initial_fuel_multiplier_percent + misfire_monitor_fuel_multiplier_step_percent x the slot's attempt count (e2m Misfire_Fuel_Multiplier 0x01165120); stored only (sth @ 0x5334e8, no reader - for the tool)

Misfire monitor: the last response value read for each slot (e2m Misfire_Cyl_N_Delta_Time 0x01165110 + offset), written by cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse (sthx @ 0x532eb4), no reader - for the tool

text: misfire monitor, e2m cross-check: the e2m Misfire_* parameters sit at fixed offsets from the firmware blocks - ROM 0x6445c = 0x01164E00 (attempt limit ... test wait count 0x6447a = 0x01164E1E), RAM 0x40b9ee = 0x01165100 (attempt numbers), 0x40b9fe = 0x01165110 (delta times), 0x40ba0e = 0x01165120 (fuel multiplier), 0x40ba10 = In_Plant_Delay_Timer, 0x40ba12 = Monitor_Run, 0x40ba13 = Test_Cylinder_Number, 0x40ba14 = Total_Attempts_Number, 0x40ba16 = CBD_Compensation_Disable, 0x40ba18 = CBD_Enable; flags: operating_mode_flags_cal (0x3fd5ee) = 0x01106B54 (Misfire_Monitor_Enable, mask 0x8000), protection_feature_flags (0x3fd5f0) = 0x01106B56 (Misfire_Relative_Enable, mask 1). Every offset agrees with how the code uses the word, so the e2m names corroborate; the names above rest on the code.

global 0x003fd5ee operating_mode_flags_cal comment: add bit 0x8000 = misfire monitor enable (read by cm848_initializeMisfireMonitor, lhz @ 0x532bd8). EEPROM 0x16c = 0x7ca6 has it clear, so the monitor is off on this truck (misfire_monitor_phase_code 0 in the RAM dump) and P0300-P0306 cannot come from it. global 0x003fd5f0 protection_feature_flags comment: bit 0 = misfire relative enable (selects the relative response limit in cm848_runMisfireMonitor step 2; clear in 0x67be). Also e2m Misfire_Timing_Limit_Enable (0x01106B52, mask 0x100) is bit 0x100 of engine_feature_enable_flags_cal (0x3fd5ec = 0x27EF, set): a separate misfire timing limit (Misfire_Timing_Table / Misfire_Timing_Limit / SOI_Before_MST) that is not part of this monitor - a lead for the injection timing review.

global 0x0040aefe diagnostic_monitor_complete_bits and 0x003fed94 / 0x003fed98 fault_pending_flags / fault_pending_flags_b: bit 0x100 is the misfire monitor. cm848_runMisfireMonitor step 6 sets the complete bit once the misfire fault bits (361-367 and 416 / 417) equal their previous copies, then clears the pending bit in fault_pending_flags when misfire_monitor_result is 2 or fault_pending_flags_b bit 0x100 is already clear, otherwise only in fault_pending_flags_b (a failed result needs a second complete test). The RAM dump has fault_pending_flags = 0xfffff7ff (bit 8 still set: the monitor never ran) and complete bits 0.

types: 0x003fd21e (misfire_monitor_phase_code) and 0x003fd222 (misfire_monitor_step_code) are typed word but both are accessed as dwords (stw / lwz) and sit exactly 4 bytes apart, so they render as _cbd_phase_code / _cbd_step_code - retype both to dword. 0x003fd1ff (misfire_monitor_cylinder_misfire_flags) is a byte[8] and 0x0040b9ee (misfire_monitor_cylinder_attempt_counts) a word[8] indexed by slot; 0x0040b768 (cylinder_fueling_offset) is typed byte but is a word[8] (0x40b768-0x40b777). Array types would make them read as arrays.

struct fields: governor_output_t.integrator (0x40aec2, dword) - its high word is the low speed governor idle reference speed in 1/8 rpm (6000 = 750 rpm in the RAM dump), not a PID integrator; the misfire monitor tests the engine speed against it + 80 rpm and keeps a copy (misfire_monitor_idle_reference_speed_previous). engine_rpm_state_t.target_rpm (0x40b7ac, struct comment Target engine RPM setpoint) is not a target: cm848_updateEngineSpeedFromCrankSignal (0x44374) stores exponentialMovingAverage(engine_rpm_measured) in it (and cm848_setEngineRpmFromCalibration copies engine_speed_default_cal into it, engine_rpm_measured and current_rpm in simulation mode), so it is the filtered engine speed - the word the monitor compares with that reference + 80 rpm and with 900 rpm; rename the field (current_rpm, 0x40b7ba, is the other speed word).

UNRESOLVED polarity of the response test: cm848_evaluateMisfireMonitorCylinderResponse flags a cylinder when the value read from cylinder1_timing_offset stays ABOVE misfire_monitor_response_limit (cmpw limit, value; blt @ 0x532ecc) although e2m calls Misfire_Cyl_N_Delta_Time the 'decrease in 120 deg time when overfueled' and Misfire_Minimum_Delta_Time the 'minimum change necessary to declare a cylinder good'. cylinder1_timing_offset[0-7] are written only by hpcr_cbdFillAccelerationBuffers as (a TPU-A channel 14 parameter delta between successive same-tooth events) >> 2 (all 0 in the RAM dump, engine off); what that TPU parameter holds is not identified. A raw 120 degree period would be about 16,700 counts at 750 rpm (0.4 us ticks, >> 2) and would exceed the absolute limit 500 on every attempt, so the buffer is more likely a period difference (e2m names the block CBD_Accel_Buffer) - the value and its sign need a running-engine dump; the plate comments describe only what the code compares.

cylinder balance (CBD) family: CBD means cylinder balancing (e2m Group_Cylinder_Balance, CBD_Enable 'Cylinder Balancing Enable'), not 'cold burndown' - the cold-burndown wording in work/tasks/025 and in the old comments of 0x40b9ee / 0x40ba10 / 0x40ba13 is wrong. Still named from the CBD side and left alone: cbd_enable_flag (0x408ef6), cbd_sync_byte_a_cal, cbd_fuel_demand_blend_scale_cal, cylinder_diag_low_threshold / _high_threshold (0x408eee / 0x408ef0 = e2m CBD_Fueling_Trim_Maximum / Minimum by offset, so the low / high order needs checking), hpcr_processLoadThrottle (0x42cfc: the CBD fuel demand blend, not a throttle function) and cylinder1_timing_offset ... cylinder8_timing_offset (0x40b74c; filled by hpcr_cbdFillAccelerationBuffers, e2m has CBD_Accel_Buffer_1-8; contents not identified, see the polarity note - rename them together once the value is known).

0x003fe9d8 fault_active_status_array is the fault_registered_bits array, word 0 (fault_registered_bits_0_to_15 by the wave-2 naming; 0x3fe9e8 is already fault_registered_bits_128_to_143): cm848_runMisfireMonitor steps 4 / 5 clear the per-cylinder misfire bits in it through the fault number >> 4 index. It has many users, so it needs its own pass.

engine_protection_timerState_shiftCheck (0x52f32c) is a step of a test sequence kept in the EEPROM byte cam_sync_protection_state_flags (with diag_camSync_deviation_check 0x52f250 and cm848_checkRadiatorFanSpeedSignalNoise 0x52f448), most likely the Chrysler end-of-line (in-plant) sequence (e2m CHRY_In_Plant_MFM_Delay_Time / _Timeout): it compares BYTE_003fd1ac (a count, not identified) with misfire_monitor_warm_up_seconds_cal and with DAT_003fd946 (the byte before the warm-up byte = e2m CHRY_In_Plant_MFM_Timeout), and a misfire_monitor_result of 2 clears flag bits 0x10 and 0x20 (otherwise only 0x10 and diag_suppress_request_flag is set) - its protection / timer name is the wrong domain, a candidate for the next wave. engine_sync_type_code (0x3fd93c = EEPROM 0x4ba, 0xffff on this truck; comment 'NEVER-WRITTEN config') selects the 5100 branch of the monitor: with it the disabling-fault list and the coolant test are skipped and the warm-up is timed.

schedule: cm848_runMisfireMonitor is called from cm848_phase_group_b_processing (0xb854, odd main loop phases - 20 of the 40 per loop, 10 ms if a phase is one 5 ms PIT tick; the e2m unit of Misfire_Minimum_Idle_Time, 0.01 s per count, agrees). cm848_initializeMisfireMonitor is called once from cm848_applicationMain (0x544c4). In the automatic mode (misfire_monitor_tool_only_enable 0) the monitor runs once per key cycle: after phase 2 or 3 only the tool's run request starts another test.

plate_comment: Called as the last task of hpcr_periodicTaskSet_fuelFinal (every 4th main loop phase, 20 ms if a phase is 5 ms). Two jobs. (1) The engine overspeed monitor: the speed engine_rpm_state_t.current_rpm (1/8 rpm) at or above engine_overspeed_set_rpm_threshold (33600 = 4200 rpm) for more than engine_overspeed_debounce_limit (3) passes in a row latches engine_overspeed_active_flag, sets fault 27 (fault_detected_bits_16_to_31 0x800 = P0219 engine overspeed through ROM 0x5985a) and opens a record in engine_overspeed_log_cal (5 records of 8 bytes in the EEPROM mirror: key_on_hour_meter at the start, speed when detected, duration); below engine_overspeed_clear_rpm_threshold (32000 = 4000 rpm) it clears the flag and the fault bit in the detected and registered words, writes the duration into the record and moves engine_overspeed_log_index_cal on (modulo 5). (2) The engine start-phase state machine on cold_start_phase (CRANKING / ABOVE_RPM_TRIGGER / AT_GOVERNOR_SETPOINT / FUEL_MODE_SWITCH / SUSPENDED / ABOVE_RPM_VIA_EVENTS / SETPOINT_UNDERRUN / ENGINE_STANDBY) from the engine speed, the governor setpoint and the ignition key line; while the overspeed flag is set it moves AT_GOVERNOR_SETPOINT to SUSPENDED until the flag clears, and in ENGINE_STANDBY it counts the passes toward hardware_operation_complete_flag.
evidence: Name kept: the overspeed monitor is one part of this function. Fault 27 = fault_detected_bits_16_to_31 bit 11; ROM 0x5985a[27] = slot 23 -> obd_dtc_code_table P0219 (faults 26 / 28 are P0107 / no slot). The overspeed block is about the first 40 lines of a 181-line function whose rest is the cold_start_phase switch, so the rule keeps the name and the plate describes both jobs. Thresholds: the same five words (50 / 33600 / 32000 / 3 / 80) are at ROM 0x6c496 and in RAM 0x40687c-0x406884; the EEPROM log layout (40 bytes at 0x3fdfde, flag +0x78, index +0x7a) matches e2m ES_Calc_Overspeed_Error_Log / _Flag / _Index (0x0110DA00 / DA78 / DA7A) exactly. Not triggered on this truck: log, flag and index are 0 in the RAM dump and the EEPROM dump.

Passes in a row (every 4th main loop phase) with the engine speed at or above engine_overspeed_set_rpm_threshold; zeroed when the speed is below it or when the count passes engine_overspeed_debounce_limit and the overspeed latches (sth @ 0x1c2e0 / 0x1c2fc / 0x1c3c0, lhz @ 0x1c2d8); only mpc555_processColdStartMainLoop touches it (whole-binary sweep). Kernel-image window RAM, but no boot call lands on it

The engine overspeed latch, byte: set with fault 27 (P0219) when the debounce completes, cleared with the fault when the engine speed falls below engine_overspeed_clear_rpm_threshold (stb @ 0x1c304 / 0x1c3e4, lbz @ 0x1c2a8); while it is set the start-phase state machine moves AT_GOVERNOR_SETPOINT to SUSPENDED (no other reader in the whole-binary sweep). Nothing to do with cold starting

Engine speed that starts the overspeed debounce, 1/8 rpm: 33600 = 4200 rpm. ROM-copied calibration (ROM block 0x6c496 -> 0x40687c, outside the EEPROM mirror, so no _cal); lhz @ 0x1c2c4, the only reader

Engine speed below which the overspeed latch and fault 27 clear, 1/8 rpm: 32000 = 4000 rpm (200 rpm under the set threshold). ROM-copied calibration (ROM 0x6c49a, outside the EEPROM mirror, so no _cal); lhz @ 0x1c3d4, the only reader

Passes the engine speed must stay at or above the set threshold before the overspeed latches: the monitor needs the count to exceed this value, 3, i.e. 4 passes = 80 ms. ROM-copied calibration (ROM 0x6c49c, so no _cal); lhz @ 0x1c2ec, the only reader

1 while a record of engine_overspeed_log_cal is open (set when the overspeed latches, cleared when it clears; sth @ 0x1c364 / 0x1c458, lhz @ 0x1c32c); EEPROM mirror (EEPROM 0xbd4), so _cal; e2m ES_Calc_Overspeed_Error_Flag (DGRPOSFG, 0x0110DA78 = log + 0x78). 0 in the RAM and EEPROM dumps

Record (0-4) of engine_overspeed_log_cal being written; advances modulo 5 when an overspeed event ends (lhz @ 0x1c348 / 0x1c374 / 0x1c3a0 / 0x1c428 / 0x1c43c / 0x1c45c, sth @ 0x1c464 / 0x1c47c); EEPROM mirror (EEPROM 0xbd6), so _cal; e2m ES_Calc_Overspeed_Error_Log_Index (DGRPOSIN, 0x0110DA7A = log + 0x7a). 0 in the dumps

Engine overspeed event log: 5 records of 8 bytes at 0x3fdfde (EEPROM 0xb5c-0xb83): +0 dword key_on_hour_meter at the start (0.2 s per count), +4 word engine speed when the overspeed was detected (1/8 rpm, DAT_003fdfe2), +6 word duration in 0.2 s counts (DAT_003fdfe4, written when the event ends); e2m ES_Calc_Overspeed_Error_Log (DGRPOSLF, 40 bytes at 0x0110DA00) - the one-dword row is only the array base (stwx @ 0x1c384, lwzx @ 0x1c444). All zero in the RAM and EEPROM dumps: this truck has never logged an overspeed

text: overspeed log record layout: 0x3fdfde is a 5 x 8-byte array (dword key-on time, word speed at detection, word duration) typed as one dword - make it an array of a record struct (structure_definitions.csv / arrays.csv); the unnamed DAT_003fdfe2 / DAT_003fdfe4 that render in mpc555_processColdStartMainLoop are its +4 / +6 fields. EEPROM mirror addresses: log 0x3fdfde-0x3fe005, flag 0x3fe056, index 0x3fe058 (EEPROM 0xb5c, 0xbd4, 0xbd6).

0x0040687c cold_start_crank_event_threshold_cal (50) and 0x00406884 engine_rpm_trigger_cal (80 = 10 rpm) carry a wrong _cal: they sit in the same ROM-copied block 0x6c496 as the overspeed limits, outside the EEPROM mirror. They belong to the start-phase state machine, not to the overspeed monitor, so they are not proposed here (the state machine's names - cold_start_*, engine_rpm_trigger_*, the CSP_* enum prefix - want their own pass).

enums.csv COLD_START_PHASE: CSP_SUSPENDED (5) is documented as 'shutdown inhibit with cold mode enabled' - the code enters it from CSP_AT_GOVERNOR_SETPOINT when the former cold_start_mode_enabled_flag (now engine_overspeed_active_flag) is set and leaves it when that clears; fix the comment together with the rename. The other phases follow from the same function: CRANKING -> ABOVE_RPM_TRIGGER when the speed passes engine_rpm_trigger_cal (10 rpm) -> AT_GOVERNOR_SETPOINT when it reaches governor_rpm_setpoint_output; SETPOINT_UNDERRUN when it falls to cold_start_rpm_threshold (500 rpm); ENGINE_STANDBY when the key line (mios_mdasm30.SCRD bit 15) is off with no shutdown active, or engine_starting is 1.

shared names: none of the six misfire monitor functions and not mpc555_processColdStartMainLoop is in firmware/cross_firmware_matches.csv (its only cbd hit is computehpcr_CbdAngleCorrection 0x528e70 vs CM550 initDiagnosticProtocol 0x1ce7c, a different function), and CM550 function_renames.csv has no cbd / misfire / coldBurndown / ColdStartMainLoop name, so no unprefixed shared name and no CM550 row is needed. The old function_renames rows of all seven functions had no plate comment, so there was nothing to keep.
